source: Allard & Atalla 2e Table 11.3, PDF page 272 (printed p. 266)
about: Table 11.3, "The parameters used to predict the surface impedance of the material in Figure 11.6": a plastic foam covered by a sheet of glass wool, both bonded onto a rigid impervious wall, the first of the porous-screen examples of Sect. 11.7.1. Columns as printed: thickness h (mm), phi, sigma (N s/m4), alpha_inf, Lambda (um), Lambda' (um), rho_1 (kg/m3), E (Pa), nu and eta_s. The glass wool row is the 0.45 mm screen, which is why its flow resistivity is 1.1e6 and its density 660: a sheet, not a blanket.

rows.name: Glass wool
rows.note: The porous screen of Figure 11.6, a sheet of glass wool bonded onto the foam.
